استوطنتا (form X)
# اِسْتَوْطَنَتَا (istawṭanatā) /is.taw.tˤa.na.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَوْطَنَ (istawṭana)
# اُسْتُوطِنَتَا (ustūṭinatā) /us.tuː.tˤi.na.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَوْطَنَ (istawṭana)
